Title: General availability: Logic Apps feature of Azure App Service

Body.Content:
The Logic Apps feature of Azure App Service lets you build powerful integration solutions quickly by using prebuilt connectors to SaaS and enterprise applications and a visual designer to easily automate business processes and workflows.

Logic Apps connects seamlessly to both your on-premises systems and your cloud applications. You can also leverage existing BizTalk Server investments and connect to cloud applications. With Logic Apps, you can use other services like Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Cognitive Services to gain insights from your connected systems and make informed business decisions.

For more information, please visit the Logic Apps page and the What are Logic Apps? documentation page.

Although Logic Apps is still available for purchase through Azure App Service, you can choose a standalone pricing model, if needed. For more information, please visit the Logic Apps pricing page.
